exitSearchConclusion: No later sale, signed pending exit or ownership transfer of the Smoky Mountain platform was identified through August 16, 2026. The November 2024 TVA agreement, August 2025 financing and latest Brookfield Infrastructure Income Fund report continue to support a current 50/50 Argo-Brookfield joint venture. The terminated Apollo-Argo manager transaction did not change the platform's ownership.
